purpose: Determine whether exclude-unknown and raw-ground-only demographic reconstructions retain enough frozen predictor-complete units to support pre-outcome integrated recovery, before any real count magnitude is opened.

exclude_unknown.support_rule: >=5 distinct breeding seasons, span >=10 years, and at least one season in both the first and last thirds of 1980-2025

ground_only.record_filter: raw vantage exactly ground; aerial/offshore direct counts are excluded
ground_only.support_rule: >=5 distinct breeding seasons, span >=10 years, and at least one season in both the first and last thirds of 1980-2025

process_frames.ADPE: predictor-complete CCAMLR primary frame from Gate 2E-A/V2
process_frames.CHPE: predictor-complete APBP-region primary frame from Gate 2E-A/V2
process_frames.GEPE: predictor-complete species-wide primary frame from Gate 2E-A/V2

classification.coverage_limited: <20; report unavailable and do not broaden ground-only to all direct observations

downstream_recovery.nuisance_calibration: shared image offset and accuracy scales continue to be calibrated from the full frozen synthetic metadata in integrated recovery
downstream_recovery.filtered_role: the sensitivity filter applies to the records used for demographic reconstruction/process fitting
downstream_recovery.thresholds: use the same focal forcing/AxH recovery thresholds as the integrated primary estimator; do not relax for a sensitivity

boundary: No real count magnitude is summarized, transformed, compared or modeled.
The count column is used only as a non-missingness flag to reconstruct the already-frozen cohort.
No radius, site trait, temporal window, forcing partition or interaction may change.
Ground-only means raw ground exactly, not the broader direct family.
